name: Sulagna Kar / ସୁଲଗ୍ନା କର

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sulagna Kar writes Odia poetry and critical reviews. Kabita Live’s contributor note describes her as a sociology lecturer in Odisha, bringing teaching and literary work into the same writing life.

In “ଗୋଟିଏ ଶବଦରେ”, she asks whether a single word might hold a poem addressed to another person. Flowers, fallen petals and the weariness of life’s stage carry feelings that words cannot easily contain. The poem moves towards an intimate pairing of “you” and “I”, while retaining the difficulty of making emotion understood.
